description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the schedule to the order published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1944/03 of 07.12.2015 in relevant to the Horizen College of Business & Technology (Pvt) Ltd.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - an Order issued under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It amends the schedule of a previous Order published in the Gazette, specifying conditions and requirements for degree programs offered by a private educational institution. While it mentions a Minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on statutory compliance, regulatory requirements, and amendments to existing legal frameworks rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
